features: Packed with a massive 7000mAh battery, the OnePlus N6x carries you through daily tasks, long video streams, and extended browsing sessions without hunting for an outlet. Engineered with long-term health optimization, it provides up to 6-year battery health to maintain peak performance over time.

Experience seamless software experience backed by 48-months smoothness certification straight out of the box. Engineered for long-term system optimization, every app launch, swipe, and multitasking transition remains snappy, fluid, and lag-free over time.

Powered by the Dimensity 6360 Apex processor and backed by a large 5300mm2 Cooling System, this setup handles daily multitasking and continuous app switching without slowing down or heating up. Paired with a liquid-fluid 120Hz refresh rate display, it ensures smooth scrolling, instant touch response, and seamless visual rendering throughout your everyday use.

Built to withstand everyday accidents, unexpected weather, and sudden impacts with certified military-grade durability (MIL-STD-810H) for shock resistance. Paired with an IP64 rating for dust and water resistance, it gives you reliable peace of mind during everyday carry.

Capture clear, natural photos with rich contrast using the main 13MP camera system, preserving details across diverse lighting conditions. Up front, the 5MP camera locks in sharp, clear selfies for photos and video calls.
Storage: 4 GB RAM, 128 GB Internal Memory
Display: 17.30 cm (6.8 inches, measured diagonally from corner to corner), 1570 x 720 Resolution, HD+ LCD screen
Sensors: Proximity sensor, Ambient light sensor, E-compass, Accelerometer, Side fingerprint sensor
